# UI/UX comparison workspace

This is a fictional local banking UI exercise. Respond in conversational
Indonesian. Use only `input/brief.md`, `input/data.js`, and `prompt.md` as task
materials. Never read a sibling workspace, previous result, or the guide's UI
as a design reference. Do not fetch outside assets or publish any result.

Complete the requested local output. Preserve fixture values and semantics.
Do not install packages or alter operating-system settings. Do not ask for
real customer data or connect to financial systems.
Keep generated design notes and persisted design references under `output/`.
If a skill offers a persistence output directory, use `output/` rather than
the generic project-root example. Do not modify input or customization files.

If any available skill references a different client layout, resolve its
bundled resources from the directory containing its own SKILL.md. Do not
assume CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is defined. The user's offline single-file brief
takes precedence over recommendations for external fonts or frameworks.

If output/index.html already exists, stop and ask for a new run location.
Do not overwrite or use a previous output as a starting point.
